reading:
De Zerbi expresses delight over Spurs' resilience and style after Coventry victory.

Roberto De Zerbi is described as 'very happy' and 'delighted' by multiple outlets, including Flashscore.co.za, VAVEL.com, Yellow Advertiser, Vodacom Soccer, and TribalFootball. He praised Tottenham's 'attitude,' 'mentality,' and ability to 'turn on the style' following their crucial win against Coventry.
